findings.evidence: f"SELECT id, total FROM invoices WHERE organization_id = ? AND id = '{invoice_id}'",
findings.reason: This SQL text injects `invoice_id` directly via f-string interpolation instead of using a bound placeholder, so untrusted input is part of SQL syntax and violates the requirement to keep values separate.
This computes a derived invoice list (`filter`/`sort`) inside render without `useMemo`, which contradicts the lesson’s requirement to memoize expensive pure derivations.
